blurb: The C-U Herb Society began in October, 1975, when eight local women decided to study the lore and uses of herbs. As their interest and membership grew, they planted a garden at Meadowbrook Park in Urbana; this garden has evolved over time yet remains a lovely gem in the community, maintained by Herb Society members.
